Open Rules Transparent rules, encoded and shared — no hidden terms, no closed-door changes. Community Votes Decisions are made by members, not executives. One community, one voice. Permanent Record Every transaction lives on a public ledger, so the record can be checked by anyone. MEMBERSHIP PACKAGES Choose Your Path Select the package that fits your goals. items.text_excerpt: Home Privacy & Policy Terms & Conditions Sign In Privacy Policy U CENTER Decentralized Stakeholder Ecosystem Version: BETA · Last Updated: April 2026 · Jurisdiction: the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Legal Entity: U-Center BETA NOTICE: U CENTER is currently operating as a beta platform. This Privacy Policy reflects our current data practices, which may evolve as the platform matures. We will notify participants of material changes. Your continued use of the Platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy. Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains — in plain language and in full detail — what personal information we collect when you use the U CENTER Platform, why we collect it, how we use it, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and what rights you have over it. We have written this Policy for two audiences: everyday participants who want a clear, honest explanation of how their data is handled, and partners or legal teams who need the technical and regulatory specifics. Both will find what they need here. Plain language summary: We collect only what we need to run the Platform. We do not sell your data. On-chain data is public by design. You have rights over your off-chain data. We are bound by the laws of the UAE. 1. Who We Are This Privacy Policy is issued by U-Center (referred to in this document as "we," "us," or "the Company"). We operate the U CENTER Decentralized Autonomous Organization (the "Platform" or "DAO"), which serves as the community governance and stakeholder infrastructure layer for the U-TOPIA ecosystem. The Company is incorporated and operates under the laws of the United Arab Emirates (UAE). We act as the data controller for personal information collected through the Platform. Where we engage third-party service providers to process data on our behalf, those parties act as data processors subject to contractual data protection obligations. For all privacy-related enquiries, contact our designated privacy point of contact at: privacy@u.center Note: The legal entity name above is a placeholder and will be confirmed prior to the final launch of the Platform. This document will be updated accordingly. 2. Scope of This Policy This Policy applies to: All registered participants (DROPs) in the U CENTER ecosystem Visitors to U CENTER websites, applications, and digital properties Governance participants, including those submitting or voting on proposals Anyone accessing U CENTER educational content, tools, or community spaces Business partners and integrated companies connecting to the U CENTER ecosystem This Policy covers personal information processed off-chain by the Company. It does not govern data that is published on public blockchains as part of DAO operations — that data is publicly visible by design and cannot be made private after the fact. On-chain transparency notice: By design, the U CENTER DAO records wallet addresses, FLOW states, transaction histories, distribution events, governance votes, and proposals on public blockchains. This data is visible to anyone worldwide and is a fundamental, irreversible feature of decentralised architecture — not a privacy risk introduced by the Company. 3. What Personal Data We Collect 3.1 Data You Provide Directly When you register, participate, or contact us, you may provide: Identity information: full name, display name, and any profile information you choose to add Contact information: email address and any other contact details you provide Wallet address(es): the public blockchain wallet address(es) you connect to or register with the Platform Identity verification documents: where required under UAE AML/KYC regulations, we may collect government-issued ID, proof of address, or other verification documents Communications: messages, support requests, feedback, governance proposals, and any other content you submit to the Platform or to us directly Referral and invitation data: information about who invited you to the ecosystem and who you have invited (Invite relationships) 3.2 Data We Collect Automatically When you use the Platform, we automatically collect: Device and technical data: browser type and version, operating system, device type, screen resolution, and language settings Network data: IP address, approximate geographic location derived from IP, and internet service provider Usage data: pages and features accessed, time spent, actions taken, session duration, click patterns, and navigation paths within the Platform On-chain activity: publicly available blockchain data associated with your connected wallet(s), including transaction history, FLOW state, and distribution records Cookies and tracking data: see Section 9 for full details on cookies and similar technologies 3.3 Data We Do NOT Collect We do not collect or store: payment card numbers, bank account credentials, IBAN or SWIFT details, private keys, seed phrases, or passwords to external accounts. Package purchases are completed via blockchain transactions from your own wallet. We will never ask for your private keys under any circumstances. Summary of data collected, purposes, and legal bases: Data Type Purpose Legal Basis Name & email Account creation & communications Contract performance Wallet address FLOW registration & on-chain interaction Contract performance KYC/ID documents AML compliance & regulatory obligation Legal obligation Usage & device data Platform security & improvement Legitimate interests Cookies Platform functionality & analytics Consent / Legitimate interests Invite data Ecosystem structure & distribution logic Contract performance Communications Support & governance Contract performance / Consent 4. Why We Process Your Data We process personal data only for clear, legitimate purposes. We do not use your data for purposes beyond those described here without your prior consent. 4.1 To Operate the Platform We use your data to create and manage your account, process FLOW qualifications, record Invite relationships, enable governance participation, and deliver the core functions of the DAO ecosystem. Without this processing, the Platform cannot function. 4.2 To Communicate With You We use your contact information to send you essential platform notices (account updates, FLOW changes, governance outcomes, beta announcements), respond to your support requests, and notify you of material changes to these policies. We do not send marketing communications without your explicit opt-in consent. 4.3 To Comply With Legal Obligations Operating in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), we are subject to applicable UAE laws including but not limited to anti-money laundering (AML) regulations, counter-terrorism financing (CTF) requirements, and data protection obligations. Where these laws require us to collect, verify, or retain personal data, we are legally obligated to do so regardless of your preference. 4.4 To Protect Security & Prevent Fraud We process technical and usage data to detect and prevent fraudulent activity, unauthorized access, manipulation of the FLOW system, and other threats to the Platform and its participants. This processing is in the legitimate interests of the Company and all participants. 4.5 For Educational Personalisation Where you access U CENTER educational content, we may use information about your FLOW level, participation history, and stated preferences to personalise your learning experience and suggest relevant educational resources. 4.6 For Platform Improvement (Beta) During the beta period, we analyse usage patterns, error reports, and participant feedback to identify and fix issues, improve the user experience, and develop new features. This data is used in aggregate and anonymised where possible. 4.7 For Governance Record-Keeping Governance proposals and votes are recorded both on-chain (publicly) and in our internal systems for audit, compliance, and historical reference purposes. 5. Legal Bases for Processing We process your personal data under the following legal bases as recognised under applicable the United Arab Emirates (UAE) data protection law: Contract performance: processing that is necessary to fulfil our obligations to you as a registered participant in the U CENTER ecosystem, including account management, FLOW processing, and distribution eligibility Legal obligation: processing required to comply with applicable UAE laws and regulations, including AML/KYC requirements, tax obligations, and regulatory reporting Legitimate interests: processing for purposes of platform security, fraud prevention, abuse detection, and product improvement, where our legitimate interests are not overridden by your fundamental rights and freedoms Consent: where we explicitly request your consent for a specific processing activity — such as marketing communications, optional analytics, or non-essential cookies — and you have freely given that consent. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting processing that occurred prior to withdrawal Vital interests: in rare circumstances where processing is necessary to protect the vital interests of any person 6. How We Share Your Data 6.1 We Do Not Sell Your Data We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party for their own commercial purposes. This is a firm commitment, not a policy subject to change for business reasons. 6.2 Service Providers (Data Processors) We engage trusted third-party service providers to help us operate the Platform. These providers process your data only on our instructions and are contractually bound to maintain appropriate data protection standards. They include: Cloud infrastructure providers: for hosting, storage, and content delivery Analytics providers: for platform usage analysis and performance monitoring Email and communications platforms: for delivering notifications and support responses Identity verification providers: for KYC/AML compliance screening where required Security and fraud prevention services: for threat detection and access control 6.3 U-TOPIA Affiliated Companies U CENTER serves as the shared infrastructure layer for the U-TOPIA ecosystem. We may share relevant participant data with affiliated U-TOPIA companies where necessary to operate the integrated ecosystem — for example, to process cross-company DROP events or manage shared governance. All affiliated companies are required to maintain equivalent data protection standards. 6.4 Blockchain Networks (Public On-Chain Data) As an inherent feature of DAO architecture, certain data is published to public blockchains when you interact with U CENTER smart contracts. This includes your wallet address, FLOW state, transaction amounts and timestamps, distribution events, and governance votes. This data is publicly visible globally and is not controlled by the Company once published on-chain. 6.5 Legal and Regulatory Authorities We may disclose personal data to UAE regulatory authorities, law enforcement agencies, courts, or other governmental bodies where required by applicable law, court order, or lawful regulatory request. Where permitted, we will notify you of such a request before disclosing your data. 6.6 Professional Advisors We may share data with our legal advisors, auditors, accountants, and insurers in the course of professional services, under strict confidentiality obligations. 6.7 Business Transfers If the Company undergoes a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets, personal data may be transferred to the relevant successor entity. We will provide notice through the Platform before any such transfer occurs and ensure that your data remains protected under equivalent standards. 7. International Data Transfers U CENTER operates as a globally distributed ecosystem. Your personal data may be transferred to, and processed in, countries other than the UAE — including countries that may not provide the same level of data protection as UAE law. Where such transfers occur, we implement appropriate safeguards, which may include: Standard contractual clauses (SCCs) with recipients outside the UAE Contractual data protection obligations with all service providers Adequacy assessments for countries receiving transferred data By registering with and using the Platform, you acknowledge that your data may be transferred internationally as described above. On-chain data is replicated across globally distributed blockchain nodes by the nature of public blockchain networks. This is an inherent, irreversible feature of decentralised technology and is not a transfer within the Company's control. 8. Your Rights Under applicable the United Arab Emirates (UAE) data protection law, you have the following rights in relation to your personal data. We will respond to all valid requests within thirty (30) days of receipt. Right of access: you have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, together with information about how and why we process it Right to correction: you have the right to request that we correct any personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated Right to deletion: you have the right to request the deletion of your personal data, subject to our legal obligations and the technical limitations described below Right to restrict processing: you have the right to request that we limit how we use your data in certain circumstances, for example while the accuracy of data is contested Right to data portability: where technically feasible and where processing is based on consent or contract, you have the right to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format Right to object: you have the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests, including profiling for analytical purposes Right to withdraw consent: where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time by contacting us or adjusting your account settings Right to complain: you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant UAE data protection authority if you believe your rights have been violated Important limitation on deletion rights: On-chain data — including your wallet address, FLOW state, transaction records, and governance votes — is permanently and immutably recorded on public blockchains. This data cannot be deleted, modified, or made private by the Company or anyone else. This is a fundamental, non-negotiable property of blockchain technology that participants accept by connecting a wallet to the Platform. To exercise any of your rights, please submit a written request to: privacy@u.center. We may request proof of identity before processing your request to protect against unauthorised access. 9. Cookies & Tracking Technologies 9.1 What Are Cookies? Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website or use a web application. They allow the Platform to recognise your device, remember your preferences, and collect information about how you use the Platform. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage, and pixel tags. 9.2 Types of Cookies We Use Strictly necessary cookies: essential for the Platform to function. These enable login sessions, security tokens, and core navigation. They cannot be disabled without breaking the Platform. Functional cookies: remember your preferences, language settings, and display choices to improve your experience. Analytics cookies: collect anonymised or pseudonymised data about how participants use the Platform — which features are used, how long sessions last, and where errors occur. This helps us improve the Platform during the beta period. Security cookies: used to detect and prevent fraudulent activity and unauthorised access attempts. 9.3 Cookie Management You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block all cookies, accept only certain types, or delete existing cookies. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookie

Features, rules, and terms may change as the ecosystem develops. By participating, you acknowledge that this is a pre-launch environment and that the final terms may differ from those described here. 1. Acceptance of Terms By accessing, registering with, or participating in the U CENTER Decentralized Autonomous Organization (the "DAO" or "Platform"), you ("Participant," "DROP," or "User") agree to be legally bound by these Terms and Conditions ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use or access the Platform. These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and U-Center (the "Company") and apply to all aspects of your participation in the U CENTER ecosystem, including but not limited to: account registration, package purchases, FLOW qualification, distribution participation, governance voting, and educational access. These Terms are written in plain language wherever possible. Key obligations and risks are highlighted throughout. Please read them carefully before proceeding. 2. About U CENTER U CENTER is a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) that provides a community-governed ecosystem enabling participants to engage in stakeholder-aligned value distribution, governance participation, and financial education. U CENTER is the stakeholder infrastructure layer for the U-TOPIA portfolio of aligned companies. U CENTER operates on public blockchain infrastructure. Distributions, FLOW states, and governance decisions are recorded on-chain and are publicly verifiable. The DAO treasury is governed by community vote. No single individual or entity has unilateral control over the distribution protocol once deployed. 3. Eligibility To participate in U CENTER, you must: Be at least 18 years of age (or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher) Not be a resident of, or subject to the laws of, any jurisdiction where participation in DAO ecosystems or blockchain-based value distribution is prohibited or restricted Not be listed on any applicable sanctions list, including those maintained by the UAE, UN, US OFAC, or EU Have the legal capacity to enter into binding agreements Provide accurate and complete registration information U CENTER reserves the right to refuse, suspend, or terminate participation for any account that does not meet these eligibility requirements. 4. Beta Platform Disclaimer U CENTER is currently in BETA. This means the platform, smart contracts, compensation architecture, governance mechanisms, and these Terms are all subject to material change without prior notice during the beta period. During the beta period: Features may be added, modified, or removed at any time Smart contracts may be upgraded or redeployed FLOW qualifications and distribution parameters may be adjusted The DAO governance framework may be restructured These Terms may be updated, and continued participation constitutes acceptance of updated Terms The Company will make reasonable efforts to notify Participants of material changes through the Platform. However, it is your responsibility to review the current Terms before each session of participation. 5. FLOW System & Participation Participation in U CENTER is structured through the FLOW system (F0–F20). Your FLOW level determines your eligibility to receive distributions from DROP events within the ecosystem. FLOW may be acquired by: Purchasing an eligible package through the Common Portal or Private Portal Earning FLOW by achieving qualifying volume (QV) thresholds across your CHANNELs Receiving Gifted FLOW from another participant via a P2P gift link Being granted FLOW by the DAO through a governance decision FLOW is an on-chain state variable. It is not a guarantee of income, a financial instrument, or a security. Higher FLOW levels reflect greater ecosystem contribution and unlock eligibility for broader distribution participation. Important: FLOW eligibility does not guarantee distributions. Distributions depend on DROP activity within your CHANNEL network and the qualification criteria being met at the time of each DROP event. 6. Distributions & Value Flow When a DROP event occurs within the ecosystem, the smart contract automatically processes a deterministic cascade of distributions to eligible upline participants in the following order: Drop Match Bonus (DMB), Initial Ripple (IR), Repple Wave (RW), and Deep Ripple (DR). Each distribution requires the receiving participant to meet the applicable FLOW threshold. Any distributions that cannot be assigned to a qualifying upline participant at the time of a DROP event are automatically routed to the U CENTER DAO treasury. These funds are not retained by the Company as revenue. The DAO treasury is governed by community vote. Distributions are not income guarantees. Past ecosystem activity does not predict future distributions. Participation in U CENTER is subject to market, technical, and regulatory risks. Please do not participate with funds you cannot afford to lose. 7. No Investment Representation Participation in U CENTER does not constitute an investment in any security, fund, or financial instrument. Shares generated within the ecosystem are internal governance and participation units and do not represent equity, debt, or any other financial claim against the Company or the DAO treasury. U CENTER does not guarantee any return, distribution, profit, or income from participation. Any financial outcome from participation depends entirely on your own activity, your CHANNEL network, ecosystem growth, and market conditions, none of which the Company controls or can predict. This Platform is not regulated as a financial services provider in the UAE or any other jurisdiction as of the date of these Terms. If regulations change, the Company will take appropriate steps to ensure compliance. 8. Intellectual Property All content, branding, educational materials, platform design, smart contract code, and documentation produced by U-Center and the U CENTER ecosystem are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or commercially exploit any such materials without prior written permission. Content you contribute to the ecosystem (e.g., governance proposals, community content) remains your intellectual property, but by submitting it you grant the DAO a perpetual, royalty-free licence to use, display, and distribute that content within the ecosystem. 9. Prohibited Conduct You agree not to: Use the Platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of applicable UAE law Attempt to manipulate, game, or exploit the FLOW qualification or distribution system Create false or misleading accounts or impersonate any person or entity Introduce malicious code, bots, or automated tools to interact with the smart contracts without authorisation Make false representations about potential earnings or distributions to other participants Engage in money laundering, terrorist financing, or any other financial crime Violate the rights of other participants, including their privacy and intellectual property rights 10. Limitation of Liability To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, U-Center and its affiliates, officers, directors, and contributors shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your participation in U CENTER, including but not limited to loss of distributions, loss of FLOW status, smart contract errors, blockchain network failures, or regulatory changes. The Company's total liability to you for any direct damages shall not exceed the value of packages or fees paid by you to the Platform in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. 11. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United Arab Emirates (UAE). Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or in connection with these Terms or your participation in U CENTER shall first be subject to good-faith negotiation between the parties. If a dispute cannot be resolved through negotiation within thirty (30) days, it shall be referred to binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the relevant UAE arbitration authority. The seat of arbitration shall be the UAE. The language of arbitration shall be English. 12. Amendments The Company reserves the right to amend these Terms at any time, particularly during the beta period. Updated Terms will be posted on the Platform with a revised date. Your continued participation after the posting of updated Terms constitutes your acceptance of those changes. For material changes, the Company will make reasonable efforts to provide at least fourteen (14) days' notice through the Platform before the changes take effect. 13. Contact For questions about these Terms, please contact: contact@u.center U CENTER · Terms & Conditions · April 2026 · BETA VERSION Governed under the laws of the United Arab Emirates (UAE). Legal entity: U-Center The learning home of the U-TOPIA ecosystem, where understanding comes first, and governing is a shared responsibility.
